intro: In the Undercity, Keeper Bel'dugur commissions expeditions to recover dark tomes and magical artifacts for his people. The scholarly Forsaken works deep within the Apothecarium.

p: Among the Apothecarium's vats and researchers, Keeper Bel'dugur sends adventurers to recover dangerous arcane and occult relics from across Azeroth. The Book of Ur, a legendary treatise on extra-dimensional beings, is locked away inside Shadowfang Keep and draws his keen interest. While many in the Undercity seek magical knowledge to cure or weaponize undeath, Bel'dugur's curated acquisitions seem chosen to uncover ancient, forbidden powers.
